what_happened: The command was RIGHT, but the ego's plan (orange) drifted left of the recorded path and of the lead car 9 while it slowed from 11 to 6 m/s approaching the intersection. It ended up past the left lane edge, at the median island near the stop line, about 7.5 m from where the human drove.

On the approach to a signalized intersection, the policy's planned path bent left away from the recorded route, which went straight and then right (command STRAIGHT, then RIGHT). The ego slowed from 14 to 7 m/s and drifted left toward the raised median nose, going off the drivable area about 7.5 m from the human path, with no collision.

The ego was approaching a signalized intersection with a RIGHT command, slowing from about 14 to 6.6 m/s behind lead vehicle 9. Instead of holding its lane, it yawed left (the map shows the lane lines tilting away from its heading) and drifted onto the left median island before the stop line, ending up about 7.5 m off the recorded path. That registered as offroad; there was no collision.

The route command was RIGHT, but the ego drifted to the far-left edge of the approach and planned a path curving up-left toward the corner curb, not into the right turn. It slowed from 8.8 to 5.0 m/s and went off the road at 12.2 s, 15.6 m from where the human drove. The camera smearing appears only after the ego has already strayed far from the recorded path, so it looks like a result of the mistake, not the cause.

With a RIGHT command, the ego drifted left of its route into the left lanes, ending up 7.4 m from the recorded human path. There it drove into bus 127, which was turning through the intersection into those lanes toward the ego. The ego slowed only gradually (10 to 6.3 m/s) and hit the bus with its front at 9.8 s.

The route said RIGHT, but the policy kept going straight in a left lane, about 7.5 m off the human's path. Bus 127 was turning across the intersection ahead and ended up in the ego's lane. The ego only eased off (10.1 to 6.1 m/s) as the gap shrank from 31 m to 6.5 m, and its front hit the bus. The bus hit the ego's rear later, which doesn't change the cause.

The route command was RIGHT, but the ego drifted left, about 7.6 m off the recorded path, into the lane that bus 127 was turning into from the cross street. It slowed only gradually, from 10 to 6.4 m/s, while the gap closed from 23 m to 4 m, and its front hit the bus head-on.

The command was RIGHT and the recorded path stayed in the right lanes, but the ego stayed in the left lanes and drifted further left, ending 7.6 m off the recording. A bus (127) turning left out of the intersection then crossed into those lanes. The ego could see the bus for about 2 s but only slowed gently from 10 to 6 m/s and hit it head-on.

The route command was RIGHT, but while slowing toward the red light (14 down to 6.6 m/s) the ego steered left, away from the recorded path. It went over the left lane edge at the nose of the median just before the stop line, ending 7.5 m from where the human drove. No collision occurred, and the camera view looked fine before the failure (the smearing only shows up near the end).

On the approach to the intersection, the ego slowed from 14.6 to 7.5 m/s but drifted left, off the green route path (which curves right for the RIGHT command). It then drove onto the nose of the left median island, about 7.4 m from the recorded human trajectory. No collision was involved, and the camera view was still reasonably intact before the drift.

The route command was RIGHT and the route path curved right through the intersection. The ego instead stayed in a lane left of that path, and its own planned path (orange) bent left toward the median island. It slowed from about 10 to 6 m/s and ran off the road at the nose of the median by the stop line, about 7.5 m from the recorded trajectory. No collision was involved, and the camera view looked fine before the failure.

Although the route command was RIGHT, the ego went straight and drifted about 9 m left of the recorded path into the left-side lanes, which appear to be oncoming traffic. A bus (127) visible in the camera from 7.4 s turned out of the intersection into those lanes and came toward the ego, and the ego hit it head-on at about 7 m/s after braking only slightly from 9 m/s.
